implementation: Separate typed physics backend plus existing generated game rules; no Guest, emulated registers/FPU stack, instruction dispatcher, original native library calls, or physics fallback in GPU runner. One independent world per logical lane. Full World+Scene fanout and selected compaction copies retain all scratch/inactive bytes.
snapshot_scope: Post-qualification hashes and actual dependency source copies. Core sources frozen throughout runs; runner restored byte-for-byte to archived byte-copy baseline after neutral eight-byte-copy experiment. This receipt does not claim a pre-run hash manifest was taken.

toolchain.notes: -O3 is the host optimization flag; Ofast-compile=mid reduces device compiler effort without enabling fast math. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES removed from child environment. No competing compute/compiler jobs during final matrix.

contract.default_prefix: Host constructs only EMPTY deterministic storage templates; actual initialize/reset/prefix physics all execute on GPU. No device giant aggregate constructors.
contract.host_prefix: Explicit --host-prefix runs typed host physics under default RN environment/x87 CW027f, then uploads and rebinds. This is reported separately and never automatically selected.
contract.fanout: Full object representations copied, then all body pointer scratch slots rebased and live external pointers rejected.
contract.selected_state_check: Two selected copies compared byte-for-byte against their source after pointer normalization to nonzero base0x100000, then both independently step once and compare Frame plus all World+Scene bytes again. This proves snapshot/continuation coherence, not full native-versus-typed object-representation identity.
contract.rank: GPU stable canonical Result comparator with candidate-index tie break; every emitted native result/rank byte compared.
contract.timing: Process wall includes executable startup, CUDA context/setup, allocation, cold storage upload, one prefix/fanout/rollout/rank/selection, result output and teardown. Internal warmed phase samples use one warmup and three iterations with allocations resident. Validation-only extra continuation is excluded from timing runs; full fanout/selected-copy remain included. No division of four-iteration process wall into single-workload wall.

gpu8_four_modes.scope: GPU prefix and explicit typed host prefix, each final-only and fulltrace; native2096B packets, selected full-state+continuation checks all pass

host.scope: 8-candidate prefixes0/100,trace/final-only; native result/rank equal and copied-state continuation checks0errors

summary.conclusion: Correctness-qualified experimental implementation on the declared fixtures. Current complete GPU path is slower than best tested native CPU and does not meet5x. No promotion or overall speedup claim.

copy8_experiment.reason: No useful overall gain: fullfanout slowed roughly8to10ms while small selected-copy/rank improved4to1.8ms; aggregate~124ms unchanged. All bytes/scratch preserved and packets/state tests passed. Simpler byte-copy baseline restored.

limits: This runner is a fixed-future batch, not the persistent beam/policy search API.

Native comparison is exact Result/frame-derived digest and rank packets for declared fixtures; typed selected-state fullbyte checks compare clones of the typed state. Fullscene hidden-state native qualification belongs to separate scene/game gates.
Only tested V100 sm70/CUDA12.9 flags and pinned native library declared here. No approximate fallback or general arbitrary-FPU claim.
No five-times target achieved; no extrapolated performance claim for other horizons/batch sizes.
